reasoning_content: Frontend logs empty and not started. Let me check its status and whether node/pnpm are found. The process-compose was started earlier without node in PATH! The frontend command is `pnpm dev`. process-compose was launched with PATH only including ~/.local/bin and /usr/local/bin. pnpm is at /usr/local/bin/pnpm? Let's check. corepack enable created shims in /usr/local/bin probably. Let me check.

action.command: ls -la /usr/local/bin/ | grep -E "pnpm|node|corepack|uv"; echo "---"; which pnpm node; echo "--- status ---"; curl -sS -m 10 http://localhost:8080/process/frontend 2>/dev/null | head -c 500

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ls -la /usr/local/bin/ | grep -E \"pnpm|node|corepack|uv\"; echo \"---\"; which pnpm node; echo \"--- status ---\"; curl -sS -m 10 http://localhost:8080/process/frontend 2>/dev/null | head -c 500", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check binaries and frontend status"}
